Conditions raised by zupix

Source: R/conditions.R
zupix-conditions.Rd

Every error zupix raises is a condition of class zupix_error with one more specific subclass. Handle them by class, for example with tryCatch(..., zupix_limit_error = function(e) ...), never by matching the message text, which may change.

Details

  • zupix_input_error: an argument is invalid, or channels asks to remove a channel the image has. Field arg names the argument.

  • zupix_format_error: the input has no PNG, JPEG, WebP or QOI signature, or format names a different format from the one the signature shows.

  • zupix_unsupported_error: the image is valid but uses a feature zupix does not decode.

  • zupix_decode_error: the image is corrupt, truncated or inconsistent. No partial image is returned.

  • zupix_limit_error: a limit from pix_limits() was exceeded. Fields limit (its name, such as "max_pixels"), value (what the image needs) and cap (the limit). Raised before the pixels are allocated.

  • zupix_encode_error: an encoder failed or a format's own limit was hit.

  • zupix_io_error: a file or connection could not be read or written.

  • zupix_memory_error: memory could not be allocated.

  • zupix_internal_error: zupix's C code returned a status it should never return. This is a bug; please report it.

Each condition from a decoder also carries format, the format being decoded, and detail, the decoder's own message where there is one.
